description: Consolidation figure for the final report: ClinVar variant-class composition by clinical significance, the two structural/positional null tests with Wilson intervals, cumulative ovarian cancer risk by gene, and the RAD51D causal chain
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 11))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.33, wspace=0.26)

# ---------------- Panel A: ClinVar composition ----------------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
cats = ['Pathogenic /\nlikely pathogenic', 'VUS', 'Benign /\nlikely benign']
totals = np.array([297, 947, 723])
missense = np.array([1, 765, 13])
other = totals - missense
x = np.arange(3)
axA.bar(x, other, 0.6, label='truncating, splice, CNV, other', color='#2c5f8a')
axA.bar(x, missense, 0.6, bottom=other, label='missense substitution', color='#d9822b')
for i, (t, m) in enumerate(zip(totals, missense)):
    axA.text(i, t + 25, f'n = {t}\nmissense {m}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
axA.set_xticks(x); axA.set_xticklabels(cats, fontsize=9)
axA.set_ylabel('ClinVar records (retrieved 2026-11-19)')
axA.set_ylim(0, 1150)
axA.set_title('A. Only one of 297 pathogenic RAD51D records is a missense change', fontsize=10.5, loc='left')
axA.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc='upper right')

# ---------------- Panel B: positional and structural null tests ----------------
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
tests = [
    ('VUS residues in the\nRecA-like ATPase core\n(84-328)', 233, 314, 0.747, 0.608),
    ('VUS residues at an\ninter-subunit interface\nin BCDX2 (PDB 8OUZ)', 101, 296, 0.334, 0.424),
]
ys = np.arange(len(tests))[::-1]
for y, (lab, k, n, exp, p) in zip(ys, tests):
    lo, hi = stats.binomtest(k, n).proportion_ci(confidence_level=0.95, method='wilson')
    obs = k / n
    axB.errorbar(obs, y, xerr=[[obs - lo], [hi - obs]], fmt='o', color='#2c5f8a',
                 capsize=5, markersize=9)
    axB.plot([exp, exp], [y - 0.25, y + 0.25], color='#c0392b', lw=2.5)
    axB.text(hi + 0.012, y, f'observed {obs:.3f}, expected {exp:.3f}\none-sided binomial p = {p:.3f}',
             va='center', fontsize=8.5)
axB.set_yticks(ys); axB.set_yticklabels([t[0] for t in tests], fontsize=8.5)
axB.set_xlim(0.25, 0.98); axB.set_ylim(-0.6, 1.6)
axB.set_xlabel('proportion of missense VUS residues (95% Wilson interval)')
axB.set_title('B. Missense VUS carry no positional or interface signal\n(red line = expectation from residue counts)',
              fontsize=10.5, loc='left')
axB.axvline(0, color='none')

# ---------------- Panel C: cumulative ovarian cancer risk to age 80 ----------------
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
genes = ['population\nbaseline', 'BRIP1', 'RAD51C', 'RAD51D', 'BRCA2', 'BRCA1']
risk = [1.3, 5.8, 11.0, 13.0, 17.0, 44.0]
cols = ['#8c8c8c', '#7fa8c9', '#5b8db5', '#d9822b', '#2c5f8a', '#1b3a52']
axC.barh(genes, risk, color=cols)
for g, r in zip(genes, risk):
    axC.text(r + 0.7, g, f'{r}%', va='center', fontsize=9)
axC.set_xlabel('cumulative tubo-ovarian cancer risk to age 80 (%)')
axC.set_xlim(0, 52)
axC.set_title('C. RAD51D is a moderate-penetrance tubo-ovarian cancer gene\n(Yang 2020 PMID 32068527; Kuchenbaecker 2017 PMID 28632866)',
              fontsize=10.5, loc='left')

# ---------------- Panel D: causal chain ----------------
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1]); axD.axis('off')
steps = [
 'Germline truncating RAD51D allele\n(NM_002878.4), haploinsufficient carrier',
 'Somatic loss of the wild-type allele in a\nfallopian tube secretory epithelial cell',
 'No functional RAD51D: BCDX2 cannot\ncomplete its two composite ATP sites',
 'RAD51 filament nucleation fails,\nhomologous recombination is lost',
 'Branch: TP53 intact -> G2/M arrest,\nsenescence, the clone is eliminated',
 'Branch: TP53 already inactivated ->\narrest bypassed, clone survives',
 'Error-prone repair, genome-wide LOH,\nserous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma',
 'High-grade serous tubo-ovarian carcinoma;\nHRD confers platinum and PARPi sensitivity',
]
ycur = 0.97
face = ['#dce7f0']*4 + ['#f2dede', '#e4f0df'] + ['#dce7f0']*2
for s, f in zip(steps, face):
    axD.text(0.5, ycur, s, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.4,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.42', facecolor=f, edgecolor='#4a4a4a', lw=0.8),
             transform=axD.transAxes)
    ycur -= 0.122
for yy in [0.885, 0.763, 0.641]:
    axD.annotate('', xy=(0.5, yy - 0.025), xytext=(0.5, yy),
                 xycoords='axes fraction', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#4a4a4a'))
for yy in [0.397, 0.275]:
    axD.annotate('', xy=(0.5, yy - 0.025), xytext=(0.5, yy),
                 xycoords='axes fraction', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#4a4a4a'))
axD.annotate('', xy=(0.5, 0.519 - 0.025), xytext=(0.5, 0.519),
             xycoords='axes fraction', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color='#4a4a4a'))
axD.set_title('D. Causal chain from germline allele to carcinoma', fontsize=10.5, loc='left')

plt.show()

# print the Wilson intervals for the report text
for lab, k, n, exp, p in tests:
    lo, hi = stats.binomtest(k, n).proportion_ci(confidence_level=0.95, method='wilson')
    print(lab.replace('\n', ' '), f'| {k}/{n} = {k/n:.4f} | 95% CI {lo:.4f}-{hi:.4f} | expected {exp}')
